First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: commute pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @friendsofpathways the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike to Work Wednesdays group ride

Not a group ride in the usual sense: a weekly summer bike-commute meetup. Ride to a different bikeable spot in Jackson each Wednesday morning for free coffee and breakfast with other people on bikes, then carry on to work. Run by the town's pathways nonprofit.
